prompt: Name a sovereign country in South America.
source: United Nations member states (https://www.un.org/en/about-us/member-states); twelve sovereign states on the South American continent.
valueLogic: Brazil and Argentina are produced by nearly everyone. The middle band is the countries people reach after a moment's thought. Guyana and Suriname form a genuine tail - most players stop at ten.

answers.name: Brazil
answers.fact: Almost half the continent by area, and the only Portuguese-speaking country in it.

answers.name: Argentina
answers.fact: Second largest, and reaches from the tropics all the way to Tierra del Fuego.

answers.name: Chile
answers.fact: 2,600 miles long and never more than 220 wide.

answers.name: Peru
answers.fact: Home to Machu Picchu and to the largest share of the Amazon after Brazil.

answers.name: Colombia
answers.fact: The only South American country with coasts on both the Pacific and the Caribbean.

answers.name: Venezuela
answers.fact: Holds the largest proven oil reserves of any country on Earth.

answers.name: Ecuador
answers.fact: Named for the equator, which runs through it just north of Quito.

answers.name: Bolivia
answers.fact: One of two landlocked countries on the continent, and it still maintains a navy.

answers.name: Uruguay
answers.fact: The smallest Spanish-speaking country in South America.

answers.name: Paraguay
answers.fact: The other landlocked one. Guarani is official alongside Spanish, and most people speak it.

answers.name: Guyana
answers.fact: The only South American country whose official language is English.

answers.name: Suriname
answers.fact: The smallest sovereign state on the continent, and Dutch-speaking.

distractors.name: French Guiana
distractors.note: An overseas department of France, not a sovereign country.

distractors.name: Falkland Islands
distractors.note: A British overseas territory, not a sovereign country.

distractors.name: Panama
distractors.note: It borders Colombia, but it's in Central America.

distractors.name: Trinidad and Tobago
distractors.note: A Caribbean country, not South American.

distractors.name: Galapagos
distractors.note: Islands belonging to Ecuador, not a country.
